artworks.title: Owl on Back of Donkey, Bird on Back of Camel with Other Animals
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring various animals, including a camel, a donkey, birds, and a dog-like creature. The central focus is on a camel and a donkey, with an owl perched on the donkey's back. Birds, including a crow or raven, are flying around them or perched on the animals. A dog-like creature is shown at the feet of the donkey and camel. The background is filled with more birds in flight. The scene is set against a simple, dark background that highlights the texture and details of the animals through intricate linework and shading, giving it a woodcut or engraving style reminiscent of early European artwork.

artworks.title: Sketch of Trees with a Statue on a Pedestal
artworks.medium: graphite with red chalk on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a landscape scene with tall, slender trees lining a path leading towards a statue on a pedestal. The horizon is implied by the tree alignment and faint architectural forms in the background. The trees appear to encircle the statue, with light and sketchy pencil-like brushstrokes outlining their delicate form. Soft red and brown tones provide subtle shading, while the overall color scheme is muted with pale grays and earthy hues. The distant architectural elements are faint, keeping the focus on the natural elements and the statue.

artworks.title: Les Anes de La Butte-aux-Cailles (Donkeys at La Butte-aux-Cailles)
artworks.medium: etching in black on light brown wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a ground-level view of people, animals, and structures. The horizon is above the central line, with distant buildings against a cloudy sky. The fine etching technique features crosshatching for texture. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of brown and sepia. The scene includes a grazing cow, a person with an umbrella, another figure, cows, and various structures under a lamp post. The sky has swirling cloud patterns.

artworks.title: Donato Dell' Antella
artworks.dimensions: sheet ([irreg.] trimmed to plate mark): 19.7 × 15 cm (7 3/4 × 5 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a bust portrait of a man within an ornate frame. The man is depicted in a three-quarter view facing slightly to the right. He has a serious expression with pronounced facial features, including a furrowed brow, high cheekbones, and a long, pointed beard. His hair is short, thinning, and receding. The man is dressed in a traditional robe with a high collar, which is gathered near the neckline. The frame surrounding the portrait is intricately designed with baroque elements, including scrollwork, floral decorations, and a shell motif at the top. The bottom of the frame features a heraldic shield. In the background, there is a carved architectural border with classical motifs.

artworks.title: Aldus Pius Manutius
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait in profile of a man with long hair, a cap, a prominent nose, and a pronounced chin. He wears a high-necked robe or tunic. In the background to the left is an illustration of an anchor with a dolphin. Below the portrait is an inscription that reads "ALDVS·PIVS·MANUTIVS·R."

artworks.title: Pierre Puvis de Chavannes
artworks.description: The image shows a head and shoulders portrait of an older man facing almost directly towards the viewer, with his head slightly tilted downwards. His facial features are pronounced, with a furrowed brow, deep-set eyes, and distinctive facial hair, including a full beard and mustache. His hair is sparse and combed back. The image is monochromatic, with no visible clothing or accessories. The background is a solid, dark shade that emphasizes the illuminated features of the man, providing a stark contrast to his face.

artworks.title: Voltaire
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of a man standing with his legs slightly apart and his arms extended in front of him. He has a detailed face, including eyes, nose, and mouth, with hair falling to his shoulders. The man wears historical clothing - a long coat with buttons, knee-length breeches, stockings, and buckle shoes. The background is minimalistic with some grass or small plants. The style appears to be a detailed line drawing or etching from an older time period.

artworks.title: Voltaire
artworks.description: The image is an etching of an individual standing in profile, facing right. The person is upright, holding a walking stick in their right hand, with distinct facial features, curly hair, and wearing an elaborate coat. The background shows an open landscape with hills and a cloudy sky. The etching is inscribed with "Paris 1778" at the bottom.

artworks.title: Frontispiece
artworks.description: The image depicts an ornate title page from a historical book. Multiple figures are arranged in a structured manner. Three bust portraits are displayed across the top, with inscriptions identifying them as royals and nobility. The central figure is a woman in Elizabethan attire with a ruff and curly hair. She is flanked by two men with distinct features, one wearing a tall hat and the other a simple collar, framed by decorative cartouches. Below them are two allegorical female figures on either side of a text panel. The left figure wears a helmet and wields a spear, while the right figure is draped in robes with a floral headband, holding a branch and an open book. The backdrop includes pastoral and settlement scenes, as well as architectural elements symbolizing strength or edification. Battle and naval activities are shown at the bottom within framed panels, surrounded by Latin inscriptions. The overall scene is illustrative and detailed, combining historical and symbolic imagery.

artworks.title: Frontispiece to "The Laws and Acts of Parliament Made by King James I ..."
artworks.description: The image features a detailed illustration with several historical figures in portrait form, set within a decorative frame. In the center, the full page is framed around a title that reads "The Lawes & Acts of Parliament Made by King James the (I) and his Royal Successors Kings of Scotland Extracted and Collected from the Publick Records." Surrounding this title are eight portraits within individual oval frames. Each portrait captures only the upper torso and head of the depicted individuals. The portraits depict figures with various styles of hats or crowns, period-appropriate clothing such as tunics, cloaks, and elaborate collars. Many have detailed and somber expressions, with mostly wavy or long hair. In addition to the human figures, there are two allegorical figures labeled "MAJESTY" and "JUSTICE" depicted in scenes of power or authority, each accompanied by symbolic imagery. The background is engraved with ornate patterns, heraldic symbols, and designs, including a large shield at the bottom center, flanked by a unicorn and lion.

artworks.title: The Calmady Children
artworks.artist: Timothy Cole after Sir Thomas Lawrence
artworks.description: The image shows two children with only their upper bodies and heads visible. The child on the left is positioned slightly leaning forward with one arm raised and resting on the other's shoulder, while the child on the right is turned slightly toward the first child. Both children have curly hair and similar facial attributes. They are wearing light, flowing garments with a slightly ruffled texture on the shoulders and sleeves. The background of the image consists of a softly blurred scene resembling a landscape.

artworks.title: Clelia Cattaneo, Daughter of Marchesa Elena Grimaldi
artworks.artist: Timothy Cole after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image shows a young child standing upright, facing forward with their hands clasped in front of them. The child has softly curled hair, a small mouth, and inquisitive eyes. They are dressed in ornate clothing, wearing a long gown with textured details and a high neckline. The child holds a flower delicately. The background is a dark, intricately patterned surface, suggesting an indoor setting.

artworks.title: Filippo Cattaneo, Son of Marchesa Elena Grimaldi
artworks.artist: Timothy Cole after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image shows a young boy standing confidently with one hand on his hip. He has short, neatly combed hair and a cherubic face. The boy is dressed in an elaborate period costume, including a textured tunic with wide sleeves, an ornate collar, knee-length pants, stockings, and pointed shoes. Beside him is a small dog sitting on the floor. The background is a simple textured wall and floor. The engraving includes the artist's signature, Timothy Cole, in the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Fray Feliz Ortensio Palaucino
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated sideways in a chair. He is holding an open book, with one arm resting on the armrest. He has distinct facial features with a short beard, a mustache, and deep, focused eyes. He has tousled dark hair and wears a robe with a large white collar and an inner garment peeking out. The background is dark.

artworks.title: Philemon and Baucis
artworks.artist: Timothy Cole after Rembrandt van Rijn
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene with figures gathered around a table. The setting is a dimly lit room. The focal point is the table, which is surrounded by figures who seem engaged. A light source casts a soft glow on the table and the figures. The background is shadowy, with architectural elements vaguely discernible. The artwork skillfully uses light and shadow to create depth and draw attention to the interaction at the table. The overall mood is one of quiet reflection and warmth amidst the darkness.

artworks.title: Mrs. Graham
artworks.description: The image shows a woman from the waist up. She is positioned with her torso slightly turned to the right and her head turned to the left, looking into the distance. She has delicate facial features, a slight smile, and a softly curved jawline. Her hair is styled high with intricate twists and a decorative hairpiece. She wears an elegant gown with a low neckline, intricate detailing, a brooch at the chest, and lace cuffs. Her arms are crossed in front of her, holding a piece of fabric or a shawl. The background has dark and light tones with indistinct foliage and cloud-like forms.

artworks.title: Physalis Alkekengi
artworks.artist: Constetin von Ettinghausen and Alois Pokorny
artworks.medium: nature print//dried & pressed plant is rolled between a copper & lead plate; lead plate is electroplated & printed intaglio in brown ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows two plant stems with multiple leaves against a plain background. The color palette is primarily sepia tones, giving a vintage feel. The stems are positioned centrally, with one leaning slightly to the left and the other more upright on the right side. The leaves display their veined patterns, extending outward from each stem. At the bottom center, there is a label with text.

artworks.title: Senecio viscosus
artworks.artist: Constetin von Ettinghausen and Alois Pokorny
artworks.medium: nature print//dried & pressed plant is rolled between a copper & lead plate; lead plate is electroplated & printed intaglio in brown ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a botanical illustration of a flowering plant with broad, serrated leaves and a complex root system. The color scheme consists of various shades of brown, creating an earthy and vintage appearance. The main stem rises vertically with multiple branches bearing blossoms. Additional sections of the plant to the left and right display more flowers and leaves, while the roots extend downward with fine, fibrous lines.

artworks.title: Chaerophyllum hirsistum
artworks.artist: Constetin von Ettinghausen and Alois Pokorny
artworks.medium: nature print//dried & pressed plant is rolled between a copper & lead plate; lead plate is electroplated & printed intaglio in brown ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a botanical illustration of a plant with slender stems, large compound leaves, and clusters of small flowers on top. The color palette is sepia, giving it a vintage appearance. The plant is centered in the image, with roots at the bottom and stems extending upwards towards the top where the flowers are located. The leaves spread symmetrically around the stems.

artworks.title: Sonchus arvensis
artworks.artist: Constetin von Ettinghausen and Alois Pokorny
artworks.medium: nature print//dried & pressed plant is rolled between a copper & lead plate; lead plate is electroplated & printed intaglio in brown ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a botanical illustration of a plant with large, spiky, toothed leaves and round flower buds on long stems. The color palette consists primarily of browns and beiges. The plant's stems rise vertically with leaves extending outward towards the center, while the flower heads are positioned towards the top left. At the bottom of the image, there is a small label with printed and handwritten text.

artworks.title: Polygonatum multiflorum Monch
artworks.artist: Constetin von Ettinghausen and Alois Pokorny
artworks.medium: nature print//dried & pressed plant is rolled between a copper & lead plate; lead plate is electroplated & printed intaglio in brown ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a botanical illustration of a single stem with elongated leaves alternating on either side and small clusters of flowers hanging beneath each leaf. The color palette consists of primarily brown shades, giving the image an antique, sepia-toned appearance. The stem runs vertically through the center, with leaves extending horizontally left and right and clusters of flowers dangling slightly to the right of the stem.

artworks.title: Road Scene, Hethersett
artworks.description: The image depicts a pastoral scene with a man leading a flock of sheep down a path flanked by tall trees. The horizon is slightly above the midline and obscured by foliage. The intricate etched style shows detailed natural elements with cross-hatching and varying line thicknesses creating texture and depth. The color palette is monochrome with black and white shades emphasizing light and shadow. In the background, clouds move in the sky and birds fly. A figure rests against a tree nearby, and open fields or hills are suggested beyond the trees.

artworks.title: Road with a Farmhouse on the Right
artworks.medium: soft-ground etching and drypoint on chine applique
artworks.description: The image depicts a rural landscape viewed from a diagonal perspective. A path leads towards a tree line which obscures the horizon. The scene is painted with loose, sketchy brushstrokes in a light, ink-based technique emphasizing textures and outlines. The color scheme is monochromatic, featuring black on a beige background. Details include a fence along the path, scattered bushes, tall trees, and a rustic structure resembling a building or barn with wheels leaning against it. The sky is lightly clouded with soft, sketchy outlines.

artworks.title: Tree on a Mound
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with towering trees dominating the scene. The horizon is high with minimal sky visible through the trees. The landscape features trees and other elements. The artwork uses detailed etching brushwork with fine lines and cross-hatching to create texture. The color palette is monochrome with shades of black, gray, and white. Plants and leaves on the ground lead the eye to the trees. A path leads into the distance where a figure is sitting. The linework conveys textures.
